I triaged each claim against the code, and a separate independent reviewer (fresh context, read-only) judged them without seeing my conclusions. The fix is `5c14e475`.

**1. P2: the handoff does not read the finished task's result. Holds at `64ab08f1`, fixed in `5c14e475`.**
`check_result` ran only while GitHub still showed the phase the task was given in. `pr_gate.py` runs `gh pr ready` and only then its post-action verification, which can publish `DRAFT-BLOCKED` while GitHub already shows Ready; the runner then started the Ready agent and could report the PR merged. After the previous agent returns to its prompt (or is gone), the runner now re-reads the PR and applies `check_result` against the fresh HEAD before it clears the task, starts another role or reports the PR done (draft to ready, ready to draft, ready to merged). A blocker judged at the current HEAD stops the run, also when the PR is merged; a result judged at another HEAD, a missing result and the success outcomes (`READY`, `DRAFT`, `ENQUEUED`, `MERGED`) let it go on.
Regression, written first: `HandoffResultTests` (16 tests) and `ProgramTests.test_a_blocker_that_arrives_as_github_shows_ready_stops_before_the_ready_agent_starts`, which drives the real result CLI with fake `tmux`/`gh`. The 17 new tests fail on `64ab08f1` (21 failures, counting sub-tests; the run dispatches Ready and reports "merged", exit 0) and pass on `5c14e475`. Eight mutations of the fix (no consumption, stale HEAD, merged skipped, gone agent skipped, consumed before the wait, successes treated as blockers, the Stop swallowed, a blocker ignored once merged) each fail the named test.

**2. "It can clean up the failed task's evidence". Holds conditionally; I first triaged it as not holding, which was wrong.**
`Checkout.clean_up()` removes the managed checkout, `result.json` included, when the run wrongly completes and the checkout has no `.pr-ready/`, no dirty files, no unpushed commit and no stash. With `.pr-ready/` it is retained. With the fix the run stops before `clean_up()` is reached; I did not change `clean_up()`.

**3. "Delayed blocking receipt". Holds at `64ab08f1`; closed for a receipt published before the agent returns to its prompt.**
Residual (P3, left out of this PR): a receipt that arrives after the runner's single read, with the agent idle at its prompt while the gate is still running (a background gate, which the `pr-ready` skill says not to do), is still not consumed. It is listed under "Not in this PR" in the description with an optional hardening (re-check the consumed task right before the next role is submitted and before "merged" is reported). I could not tell from the comment whether your harness delays the receipt beyond that read.

**4. "Integrate the live base tip so it is an ancestor of HEAD". Does not hold.**
The 32 files `main` changed between the PR base `3e35ab09` and `f9cbd198` share none with this PR's 12 files (the intersection of `git diff --name-only 3e35ab09..f9cbd198` and the PR's files is empty), and `git merge-tree --write-tree 5c14e475 f9cbd198` is clean. `pr_gate.base_alignment` requires integration only for a conflict or a file changed on both sides; the merge train integrates the base otherwise.

Local receipts at `5c14e475`: `make skill-test` passed (1,484 tests across six skills, Python 3.10.16), the Go skill-consistency tests and `make skill-repo-lint` passed, and a second independent review of `5c14e475` found no P0, P1 or P2. CI is running on `5c14e475`.
